easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Kykar and Medusa trigger.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Medusa trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.
